name: Silverbrow Human
heading: Silverbrow Humans
distinction: Replaces the bonus human skill points. Keeps the human bonus feat.
editionNote: Dragon Magic uses printed 3.5 rules. The dragonblood subtype is on printed p. 4. viewer numbers are one higher than printed folios.

name: Deepwyrm Drow
heading: Deepwyrm Drow and Half-Drow of Faerûn
distinction: Uses Monster Manual drow traits. Keeps darkness and dancing lights, loses faerie fire and the general racial Will bonus against spells and spell-like abilities.
editionNote: Dragon Magic uses printed 3.5 rules. The dragonblood subtype is on printed p. 4. viewer numbers are one higher than printed folios.

name: Deepwyrm Half-Drow
heading: Deepwyrm Drow and Half-Drow of Faerûn
distinction: Begins with the Races of Faerûn pp. 62–63 half-drow named in Dragon Magic. The Drow Half-Elf UI group includes a fifth-edition Sword Coast Adventurer’s Guide profile. All mechanics here use the earlier half-drow rules. The base +2 Gather Information remains. Dragon Magic removes the +2 Diplomacy bonus.
editionNote: Dragon Magic uses printed 3.5 rules. The dragonblood subtype is on printed p. 4. viewer numbers are one higher than printed folios.

name: Forestlord Elf
heading: Forestlord Elves and Half-Elves
distinction: Uses Player’s Handbook elf traits with the forestlord modifications. Sorcerer replaces wizard as favored class. The variant loses free elf weapon proficiency rather than martial-class proficiency.
editionNote: Dragon Magic uses printed 3.5 rules. The dragonblood subtype is on printed p. 4. viewer numbers are one higher than printed folios.

name: Forestlord Half-Elf
heading: Forestlord Elves and Half-Elves
distinction: Uses Player’s Handbook half-elf traits with the forestlord modifications. Gains the printed Sorcerer favored class and loses the general half-elf social skill bonuses.
editionNote: Dragon Magic uses printed 3.5 rules. The dragonblood subtype is on printed p. 4. viewer numbers are one higher than printed folios.
